cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -A40 "export interface MenuItemProps\|export type MenuItemProps" build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts | head -50; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm ls @gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | head
